title: Loth-wolf
description: Loth-wolves were rare sights on Lothal and little was known of them, though they had been depicted on ancient cave paintings across the planet. Massive and mysterious, one of them appeared to the young, Force-sensitive Ezra Bridger in a time of need—though none of the other members of his crew seemed to see it. Eventually, the Loth-wolves helped them travel to the other side of the planet in their most desperate hour and helped them turn the tides against the Empire.
